name: Bad Rothenfelde (Germany)
description: Horizontal tricolour of white, red and white, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Bad Rothenfelde (a white salt-works tower on red under a wheel).
history: The colours white and red derive from the arms with the six-spoked wheel of the bishopric of Osnabrück.

features.role: Bad Rothenfelde arms — salt-works tower on red
